_about.size: sprite size in px (for animated strips: one frame)
_about.footprint_tiles: tiles covered on the ground (width, height)
_about.door: door rectangle [x, y, w, h] in sprite px (null = no door)
_about.collision: solid rectangle [x, y, w, h] in sprite px; its bottom edge is the Y-sort line
_about.strips: files ending in _<n>f.png are horizontal strips of n frames (see frames / ms / loop)
